HTTP/2 frame constants, packed header structs, and name lookup prototypes.

# Purpose
`fd_h2_proto.h` defines HTTP/2 protocol constants, frame identifiers, setting identifiers, and packed C data structures that match the wire format used by HTTP/2 frames. It also provides small inline helper functions to pack and unpack the `typlen` field and to extract the stream ID from a frame header. The file declares frame and setting name lookup functions that return static strings for known HTTP/2 IDs. Overall, it serves as a protocol definition header for code that reads, writes, or interprets HTTP/2 frame data.

- `fd_h2_setting_name`
